_provenance_note: CLAUDE.md: a fixture captured from our own output is worthless as a test. None of the charts below records where its expected values came from, so we cannot tell whether they were derived by hand or recorded from engine/. Treat them as smoke tests, not as evidence. Gate 1 (the practitioner checking the engine against their own charts) is what replaces them; each chart they confirm should have provenance set to their name and the date. Do not add charts here any other way.
_independently_verified_elsewhere: The solar-term boundaries these charts depend on ARE independently verified, against 312 published NAOJ values — see fixtures/naoj_solar_terms.json and engine/tests/test_solar.py. What remains unverified here is the sexagenary arithmetic layered on top.
